comparison.objective: Store keys in the initially open drawer, close it, perform an intervening placement, then retrieve the keys using only that drawer.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual chest stabilization, drawer operation, object placement/retrieval, sequencing, and memory versus hex-key use, counterholding, collar tuning, locking, and cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Complete the ordered storage/retrieval sequence, never open another drawer, close the drawer, and return both arms; numeric drawer and placement tolerances are missing. Candidate uses explicit physical-response limits.
comparison.reason: Long-horizon drawer sequencing and object memory do not test shock-absorber adjustment or dynamic commissioning.
